message.reasoning_content: We need to identify crimes based on facts. Facts: Zhang gave 100,000 RMB to Chen as bribe to get road planning assistance. Chen accepted (took money) and used his position to influence planning. That's bribery (行贿) by Zhang and possibly acceptance of bribe (受贿) by Chen. Also returning money later doesn't negate. So crimes: 行贿 (bribe giver) and 受贿 (bribe taker). Also possibly abuse of power? But Chen is public official, using position for personal benefit (accepting bribe). So we list both. The question: "只写这部分事实直接支持的罪名". Both parties are defendants: Zhang and Chen (though Chen already sentenced). So include 行贿;受贿. Also maybe "非法占有" no. So answer: [罪名]行贿;受贿<eoa>
